# LiteLLM routing retries and fallbacks — concept pack (small)

> 11 source-anchored research claims on LiteLLM routing retries and fallbacks, grouped by facet. Original confidence and source-owner limits are retained.

## Definitions

- [statement] Deployments sharing model_name form a model group. Router retries stay within the failed group; configured fallbacks move to other groups after the retry path is exhausted. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/routing · keywords: LiteLLM routing retries and fallbacks · also: https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/reliability

## Parameters and configuration

- [statement] Fallback lists are ordered model-group chains. Configure Router fallbacks as a list of source-group mappings to target-group lists, for example fallbacks=[{"bad-model": ["my-good-model"]}]. ContextWindowExceededError and ContentPolicyViolationError use context_window_fallbacks and content_policy_fallbacks instead of the generic error chain. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/reliability
- [statement] allowed_fails and cooldown_time control deployment exclusion after failures; AllowedFailsPolicy customizes thresholds by error type independently of RetryPolicy attempt counts. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/routing · keywords: LiteLLM routing retries and fallbacks · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/router.py

## How-to and procedures

- [fact] Rate-limit retries should respect provider retry-after and exponential backoff. LiteLLM exposes retry_after as a minimum delay and reads exception response headers when computing retry sleep. — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/router.py · keywords: LiteLLM routing retries and fallbacks · also: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits
- [statement] Configure finite retry, fallback, and request-timeout budgets together; router num_retries, max_fallbacks, and provider/client timeout settings describe different stages of one request. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/routing · keywords: LiteLLM routing retries and fallbacks · also: https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/reliability
- [fact] Use an error-specific retry policy. Authentication and malformed-input failures require configuration or payload repair; transient connection, rate-limit, and server failures can warrant bounded backoff. — https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors · keywords: LiteLLM routing retries and fallbacks · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/openai-python/main/README.md, https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/routing
- [statement] For proxy qualification, force a real retryable failure in a test backend. Incoming proxy mock_testing_* fallback flags are stripped; they remain usable only in direct Router tests. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/reliability

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [fact] Inference from independent retry loops: client retries can repeat an entire gateway retry/fallback chain. Set caller max_retries deliberately and measure total upstream attempts. — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/openai-python/main/README.md · keywords: LiteLLM routing retries and fallbacks · also: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors, https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/routing
- [statement] The inspected Anthropic stream router declines fallback after real content reaches the client. Test pre-content failure separately from partial-answer failure; do not assume all endpoint streams restart identically. — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/router.py
- [fact] A 429 can indicate an exhausted spend cap rather than replenishing rate capacity. Check provider error details and retry-after before repeatedly retrying or choosing a fallback. — https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors · keywords: LiteLLM routing retries and fallbacks · also: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Router num_retries differs from provider SDK max_retries. The inspected Router initializes provider retries to zero, and the routing docs direct proxy users to control attempts with num_retries. — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/router.py · keywords: LiteLLM routing retries and fallbacks · also: https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/routing
